items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 100:1
items.html: The medium challah is one of fifty. And the First Man occupied the three worlds BYA, which are six thousand levels of souls, and one part of fifty of them is 120. Now, the First Man was the challah of the world, because after the sin there remained in him only the discernment of the challah, and he should have had remaining in him 120 levels of souls; but only 100 levels remained in him. And the reason is that in the first thousand of Beriah, which are the AVI of Beriah, he did not merit their challah, but only from the ten Partzufim, from the ZON of Beriah and below. (Item 113).
